tasks.title: Import canonical filesystem skills as versioned application skills

tasks.title: Implement sovereign export, encrypted backup, restore, and disaster-recovery drills

tasks.title: Specify durable work, checkpoint, lease, attempt, and idempotency model
scope: Define portable leases, revisioned checkpoints, bounded attempts, deterministic operation receipts, fail-closed reconciliation, cancellation signals, and structured outcomes.
Implement replaceable in-memory and atomic JSON-file stores without changing the production runner.
Prove crash recovery, exactly-once replay evidence, encrypted backup, restore, and independent verification.
acceptance: State and receipt semantics are explicitly typed
A live lease cannot be stolen by a second worker
A crash after a completed side effect and before checkpoint does not repeat the effect
An ambiguous started receipt requires reconciliation rather than blind retry
Encrypted backup restores into a clean store with integrity verification
Builder self-verification is rejected
Portable durable tests and proof command pass
rollback: Keep current runner until migration gate passes

tasks.title: Persist run checkpoints and side-effect idempotency records
scope: Add migrations and compatibility layer around current runner.
Persist attempts, checkpoints, leases, cancellation, and side-effect records.
acceptance: Migration tests pass
Retry cannot duplicate a recorded side effect
Current UI behavior remains compatible
Audit sequence remains valid
rollback: Backward-compatible migration or documented restore
implementationNotes: Schema, migrations, SQLite durable adapter, transactional event/audit outbox, and run-idempotency transaction are implemented; production runner cutover and native integration tests remain.

tasks.title: Resume runs and approvals safely after restart
scope: Replace in-memory approval continuation.
Resume or safely interrupt from every critical checkpoint.
acceptance: Restart tests pass before and after each checkpoint
Exactly one terminal state is reached
No duplicate tool side effects
Expired approvals remain fail-closed
rollback: Feature flag to interrupt rather than resume
tasks.blockedReason: Requires the production persistence adapter, serialized continuation state, and durable timer ownership.

tasks.title: Define capability descriptors and permission broker contract

Policy decision and enforcement points are explicit
Descriptors are versioned

tasks.title: Implement brokered tool execution with budgets and audit
scope: Route all tool calls through schema validation, policy, approval, timeout, cancellation, redaction, idempotency, and audit.
acceptance: Direct unbrokered tool execution is impossible in production path
Malformed and unauthorized calls fail closed
Cancellation and timeouts are enforced
Audit records actor and capability version

tasks.title: Prototype risk-tiered tool isolation

No profile is adopted without rollback

tasks.title: Add secrets, signing, rotation, and key-custody architecture

tasks.title: Define governed memory types and lifecycle

tasks.title: Implement local governed memory baseline

tasks.title: Benchmark optional retrieval and temporal-memory adapters

tasks.title: Define knowledge ingestion, provenance, freshness, and invalidation contract

Untrusted content remains data, not instruction

tasks.title: Implement local versioned knowledge baseline

tasks.title: Discover local models and record measured capability profiles

tasks.title: Create adaptive reasoning controller and stopping policy specification

tasks.title: Resume approval-gated pilot work after restart
scope: Persist continuation key, durable job, revision, expiry, and checkpoint.
Pause and requeue instead of retaining an in-memory waiter.
acceptance: Approval resumes once after restart.
Rejection and expiry prevent execution.
rollback: Revert the v13 pilot feature while preserving migration and evidence records.
risks: Live remote model continuation remains unsupported.

tasks.title: Add isolated native and browser validation lane
scope: Pin actions and Node runtime.
Run native tests, build, browser E2E, accessibility, and evidence generation in disposable CI.
acceptance: Every action is pinned to a reviewed commit SHA.
Workflow has read-only repository permission.
rollback: Revert the v13 pilot feature while preserving migration and evidence records.
risks: The workflow still requires an external CI execution.

tasks.title: Expand pilot failure and mutation evidence
scope: Run 25 labeled failure scenarios.
Run at least ten semantic mutation probes.
Preserve blocked scenarios as blockers.
acceptance: Portable source-level scenarios pass.
Twelve mutants are killed.
Unexecuted scenarios remain blocking.
rollback: Revert the v13 pilot feature while preserving migration and evidence records.
risks: Curated mutation is not exhaustive AST mutation.

tasks.title: Execute all isolated pilot gates and bind independent verification to the final ZIP
scope: Run native persistence, production build, browser E2E, accessibility, clean restore, and final independent verifier.
acceptance: All mandatory gates are pass.
Verifier accepts evidence bound to final ZIP hash.
rollback: Revert the v13 pilot feature while preserving migration and evidence records.
risks: CI or dependency failures may retain DEVELOPMENT ONLY.
tasks.blockedReason: Requires execution of the isolated native and browser validation lane.

tasks.title: Decouple source build discovery from runtime SQLite initialization
scope: Open SQLite only on the first real database operation.
Keep authenticated application pages dynamically rendered.
Complete a production build without a generated native binding.
acceptance: The database module imports without opening SQLite.
The production build completes successfully with lifecycle scripts disabled.
rollback: Revert lazy initialization while preserving the isolated native lane.
risks: Production runtime still requires the verified native binding.
outOfScope: Claiming native runtime validation from a source-only build.

tasks.title: Apply every canonical migration and validate persistence through two SQLite drivers
scope: Replace journal-only runtime migration discovery with ordered hashed SQL migrations.
Support better-sqlite3 and node:sqlite through one Drizzle-compatible contract.
Validate the previously blocked persistence suites without installing a new native binary.
acceptance: All canonical migration files are recorded with hashes.
Migration drift is rejected.
The complete test suite passes with node:sqlite.
rollback: Select better-sqlite3 explicitly while retaining the canonical migration ledger.
risks: node:sqlite is an evolving Node API and remains a pilot-validation fallback.

tasks.title: Prove leases, fencing, approvals, and outbox ownership across independent processes
scope: Race independent processes for a durable lease.
Reject a stale fencing token after takeover.
Race approval resolvers and outbox publishers.
acceptance: Exactly one process wins each lease or approval race.
The stale worker cannot checkpoint.
Only the outbox lease owner can publish.
rollback: Retain the single-process regression suite if the process harness is unavailable.
risks: The proof uses one local SQLite file rather than distributed storage.

tasks.title: Prove encrypted clean restore with scoped pilot evidence and atomic interruption rollback
scope: Seed a clean scoped pilot database.
Back up and restore tenant, approval, artifact, durable receipt, audit, and verification state.
Inject interruption after target displacement and restore the original target.
acceptance: Quick check and foreign-key check pass.
Audit and artifact hashes remain identical.
Pending approval and completed receipt states survive restore.
Interrupted restore preserves the original target.
rollback: Keep the source database and displaced pre-restore database until validation succeeds.
risks: Filesystem-level power loss is not identical to injected process interruption.

tasks.title: Expand the pilot failure matrix with real SQLite and operating-system fault proofs
scope: Run database lock, disk-full, network-loss, outbox, restart, and restore interruption scenarios.
Preserve managed-browser failures as blockers.
acceptance: At least 21 of 25 labeled scenarios pass.
Every blocked scenario records the exact environment or evidence gap.
rollback: Revert the v14 proof harness without changing runtime data.
risks: The matrix is a bounded pilot matrix, not exhaustive chaos testing.

tasks.title: Execute unblocked browser gates and bind the final verifier to the v14 archive
scope: Run browser tenant switching, offline behavior, accessibility, and visual regression in the disposable lane.
Re-run the independent verifier against the frozen v14 ZIP hash.
acceptance: All browser and accessibility gates pass.
The verifier accepts evidence bound to the final archive hash.
rollback: Retain DEVELOPMENT ONLY classification.
risks: Managed browser policy or CI availability may keep promotion blocked.
tasks.blockedReason: The locally installed Chromium blocks all URLs through managed policy; the final hash-bound verifier runs only after archive freeze.

tasks.title: Inventory mandatory and optional sovereignty dependencies
scope: Generate a machine-readable dependency ledger from the lockfile and explicit runtime dependencies.
Classify locality, network, authentication, integrity, failure, fallback, and sovereignty impact.
acceptance: Mandatory external runtime dependencies are identified separately from optional remote adapters.
Unknown dependency evidence remains visible.
rollback: Remove the v15 ledger generator without changing runtime dependencies.
risks: Lockfile metadata does not prove runtime network behavior.

tasks.title: Prove a zero-key local sovereign workflow
scope: Route to a feasible local model profile.
Select governed local memory.
Execute a local tool, produce an artifact, verify it, encrypt a backup, and restore it.
acceptance: No commercial key is used.
No network attempt is recorded.
Artifact, attestation, backup, and restore hashes match.
rollback: Retain existing provider routing and remove the sovereign proof adapter.
risks: Deterministic runtime does not prove generative reasoning quality.

tasks.title: Implement portable governed memory and context-separated key hierarchy
scope: Export and import memory with scope, provenance, correction, expiry, confidence, and hashes.
Derive separated data, backup, signing, tenant, and workspace key contexts.
Apply confidence decay to stale procedural memory.
acceptance: Cross-tenant import fails closed.
Duplicate and conflict states are distinct.
Wrong context produces a different key.
rollback: Keep canonical database memory and remove only the portability adapter.
risks: Root recovery key custody is not connected to hardware security.

tasks.title: Implement signed air-gap agent handoff and return bundles
scope: Export a signed bounded task with tenant, workspace, receiver, expiry, evidence, memory, and capability limits.
Execute offline and import a separately signed result bound to the exact task hash.
acceptance: Tampering, expiry, cross-tenant scope, wrong receiver, and capability escalation fail closed.
Valid result preserves exact task binding.
rollback: Disable file-based handoff while preserving internal durable messages.
risks: Replay protection beyond expiry and bundle identity requires a persisted import ledger.

tasks.title: Implement signed offline updates with dry-run and rollback
scope: Create signed changed-file update bundles.
Verify path containment, hashes, compatibility, and downgrade protection.
Apply atomically and roll back after explicit or injected failure.
acceptance: Dry-run identifies blockers.
Injected failure restores the previous version and content.
Downgrades and invalid signatures are rejected.
rollback: Restore the prior installation directory from the generated rollback snapshot.
risks: File-level prototype does not yet execute canonical database migrations automatically.
outOfScope: Full offline npm and model artifact mirror.

tasks.title: Implement sovereignty control plane and hardware-aware placement
scope: Evaluate hardware feasibility before model utility.
Place work by tenant trust, data locality, load, hardware, and energy.
Expose locality, dependencies, network, key, update, recovery, and evidence blockers in the UI.
acceptance: Infeasible models and unauthorized nodes cannot win.
Unknown evidence remains blocking.
The UI does not collapse fatal weaknesses into a decorative score.
rollback: Remove the sovereignty page and retain existing model routing.
risks: Energy values are estimates until measured on target hardware.

tasks.title: Run a full process-level outbound network audit
scope: Start the full application with outbound traffic denied.
Capture every attempted destination, process, protocol, and decision.
acceptance: Unexpected outbound attempts are zero.
All allowed local endpoints are declared and evidenced.
evidenceRequired: Disposable environment packet or socket audit
rollback: Retain SOVEREIGN DEVELOPMENT MODE classification.
risks: Application-level guards cannot observe all native or browser traffic.
tasks.blockedReason: The current proof covers controlled adapters only; a process-level network observation lane has not run.

tasks.title: Benchmark real local model artifacts on target hardware
scope: Acquire a licensed hashed local model only in an isolated lane.
Measure load time, tokens per second, RAM, VRAM, structured output, tool use, task quality, and failure behavior.
acceptance: A real local model meets declared quality and resource floors.
Artifact, license, source, and hardware evidence are complete.
rollback: Keep deterministic local runtime for contract testing only.
risks: Model artifact size, license, and native runtime can reduce supply-chain sovereignty.
outOfScope: Packaging model weights in the source ZIP.
tasks.blockedReason: No model artifact or target-hardware benchmark was introduced in this protected-host cycle.

tasks.title: Measure energy and thermal behavior on the target sovereign node
scope: Measure idle, load, model startup, inference, storage, and thermal behavior.
Calibrate energy-aware scheduling policies.
acceptance: Estimates are replaced or bounded by measured confidence intervals.
Energy decisions cannot trigger without sufficient confidence.
evidenceRequired: Target mini-PC or GPU node measurement report
rollback: Disable energy-based automatic decisions and show estimates only.
tasks.blockedReason: Target hardware measurement is unavailable in this container.

tasks.title: Create an offline dependency and model installation bundle
scope: Bind npm packages, browser artifacts, system requirements, and model manifests to a signed install bundle.
Prove clean installation without a public registry.
acceptance: Install succeeds with registry and model hub unavailable.
Every artifact has source, hash, license, and compatibility metadata.
rollback: Return to lockfile-based online acquisition.
risks: Bundle size and redistribution licenses may be substantial.

tasks.title: Reject replayed or revoked air-gap bundles
scope: Persist consumed task and result identifiers across restart.
Validate signing-key purpose, tenant, workspace, validity, and revocation before accepting a bundle.
acceptance: A replayed task or result is rejected after constructing a new ledger instance.
A revoked or wrong-scope key is rejected before payload acceptance.
evidenceRequired: Signed handoff proof with durable replay rejection
rollback: Return to signature-only inspection while disabling executable import.
risks: The JSON ledger is not safe for multiple concurrent import processes.

tasks.title: Implement a vendor-neutral real local runtime lifecycle
scope: Provide lifecycle, artifact verification, loopback adapters, cancellation, metrics, and no-model failure.
acceptance: Remote endpoints are rejected and altered binaries or model artifacts fail closed.
rollback: Use deterministic or no-model mode while disabling generative pilot claims.
risks: Runtime protocol differences can leak through adapters.

tasks.title: Provide portable purpose-separated encrypted key custody
scope: Separate installation, tenant, workspace, data, backup, handoff, update, and verifier keys.
acceptance: Rotation, retirement, revocation, expiry, scope, and cross-purpose tests pass after reopen.
rollback: Disable signing and encrypted export if the keystore cannot be opened.
risks: Passphrase strength and filesystem compromise remain operator risks.

tasks.title: Prove dependency installation from a verified offline cache
scope: Install the exact lockfile on a clean source copy without registry access or lifecycle scripts.
acceptance: Offline install, typecheck, and sovereignty tests pass.
rollback: Return to connected lockfile installation while revoking sovereign-install claims.
risks: A stale or incomplete cache can make installation unavailable.

tasks.title: Capture process-attributed outbound network evidence
scope: Combine application connection instrumentation with process and socket observations.
acceptance: The tested sovereign workflow records no remote socket and only declared loopback attempts.

tasks.title: Add governed local retrieval without embedding dependency
scope: Provide scope-first BM25 retrieval with sensitivity, expiry, contradiction, and context budgets.
acceptance: No network or embedding is required and the index is reconstructable.
rollback: Disable automatic retrieval for high-risk workflows.
risks: Lexical retrieval may miss semantic matches.
outOfScope: Claiming parity with a measured embedding benchmark.

tasks.title: Rehearse signed offline update migrations and rollback

rollback: Restore the pre-update encrypted backup and source tree.
risks: Forward-only production migrations may require restore rather than reverse SQL.
outOfScope: Automatic rollback of irreversible external side effects.

tasks.title: Make isolated per-file tests the authoritative release gate
scope: Discover every test and require each bounded process to exit.
acceptance: All discovered tests pass without timeout and summaries are machine-readable.
rollback: Use manually bounded groups invoking the same isolated runner.
risks: Process isolation increases total test duration.
outOfScope: Removing the monolithic command as a diagnostic.

tasks.title: Execute and benchmark a hash-verified real local model

rollback: Remain in no-model or deterministic development mode.
risks: A small model may run but fail safety or quality gates.
outOfScope: Packaging weights in the source ZIP.

tasks.title: Add an operating-system or hardware key custody backend

rollback: Use the portable encrypted keystore and block high-value pilot secrets.

outOfScope: Requiring specialized hardware on every node.

tasks.title: Run real browser accessibility and offline workflow validation

rollback: Retain deterministic contract tests and block pilot classification.

tasks.title: Measure energy and thermal behavior on target hardware

rollback: Retain v16 development-only classification.
risks: Overly permissive evidence semantics can falsely promote the release.
outOfScope: Replacing external hardware proof with repository tests.

tasks.title: Prove a real local generative model against pilot thresholds
